label: r1c2
name: mask 8-layout dihedral
hypothesis: Same network, but the mask input and the output maps use all 8 combinations of transpose, y-flip and x-flip (4 flips if the grid is not square). This covers rotations and double flips that the 4-layout version cannot express, at almost the same compute. If it beats the replica, this world uses a layout outside the 4. It is refuted if it scores 0 while the replica scores above 0, or if both score 0.
